card.name: Inside arachnoiditis and split brand names
card.fires_on: The piece "oid" in the middle of "arachnoiditis", mostly in warnings about inadvertent intrathecal injection. It also fires on short letter pieces inside split-up names, such as "LE" in LEVEMIR and "E" in EIA.
